name: StaffFlow AI
author: staffflowai

sections.description:
Give your WordPress visitors a place to ask questions about your business and request a follow-up. Build an AI assistant in StaffFlow using your business information, preview its answers, then connect the Widget to the HTTPS WordPress website you control.

The free plugin is the WordPress connector, not an unlimited free AI service. A StaffFlow account and a configured AI are required. The available AI service depends on your StaffFlow plan and usage limits. Check the current plans in your workspace before subscribing.

From first question to human follow-up

  • Create an assistant from a ready-made role and your own business information.
  • Review answers before connecting the Widget to your website.
  • When lead capture is enabled in StaffFlow, visitors can deliberately share a follow-up request for your private Lead Inbox.
  • Review requests and decide the next human follow-up. No leads, sales, exact prices, or business outcomes are guaranteed.

Create a workspace: https://www.staffflowai.com/#/sign-up?utm_source=wordpress-directory&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=wordpress-plugin&sf_entry=wordpress-directory

See the connection guide at https://www.staffflowai.com/wordpress-ai-chatbot/ or try sample assistants at https://www.staffflowai.com/#/demos. Demo businesses and sample requests shown in the screenshots are illustrative, not customer results.

A deliberate, secure connection

StaffFlow AI lets a WordPress administrator connect one selected StaffFlow AI employee to one exact HTTPS WordPress website. After the administrator approves a short-lived, single-use connection in StaffFlow, this plugin loads the StaffFlow Widget automatically on the public website.

No WordPress password, StaffFlow password, StaffFlow access token, or StaffFlow API key is shared between the services or stored by this plugin.

Website Knowledge Launch

After connecting, the administrator can open a direct StaffFlow link for the same AI employee and the same public website. The website address is pre-filled for convenience, but nothing is copied automatically. The administrator checks the address and explicitly confirms the import in StaffFlow before StaffFlow reads up to five public HTML pages from the approved domain.

The import does not follow external links or read private pages. It gives the selected AI a reviewed public-website knowledge source, so the Widget can start from the business information published on that website instead of generic answers.

What this plugin does

  • Adds one administrator-only StaffFlow AI settings page.
  • Opens the secure StaffFlow connection page from WordPress Admin.
  • Uses a short-lived, single-use approval bound to the exact HTTPS website origin.
  • Stores only non-secret connection metadata locally: a connection ID, selected AI ID, selected AI name, and local connection time.
  • Loads the StaffFlow Widget only after an administrator connects it.
  • Adds a local-only WordPress Site Health check and non-secret connection summary for administrators.
  • Offers an optional, owner-confirmed Website Knowledge Launch link after connection.
  • Lets an administrator remove the local Widget configuration at any time.

StaffFlow service

This plugin connects to the StaffFlow AI SaaS service at https://www.staffflowai.com. A StaffFlow account and at least one configured AI employee are required to use the service. StaffFlow may offer paid plans; the full WordPress plugin source remains available under the GPL regardless of the selected StaffFlow plan.

StaffFlow terms and privacy information:

  • https://www.staffflowai.com/#/terms
  • https://www.staffflowai.com/#/privacy

External service and privacy

The plugin does not contact StaffFlow until a WordPress administrator chooses Connect StaffFlow AI and returns with a one-time approval. After a successful connection, the plugin loads https://www.staffflowai.com/widget.js on public pages so visitors can use the selected AI employee.

The plugin itself does not collect visitor chat messages, visitor contact details, passwords, access tokens, or analytics. The local WordPress database retains only the non-secret connection metadata described above. Visitor interactions with the Widget are processed by StaffFlow AI to provide the requested AI service. Site administrators should review the suggested StaffFlow text in WordPress’s privacy-policy editor and publish an appropriate privacy notice for their visitors.

Removing the local connection or uninstalling the plugin deletes the locally stored connection metadata. A website connection can also be revoked from the relevant StaffFlow workspace.
sections.installation:
1. Create your StaffFlow workspace, configure an AI with your business information, and preview its answers. You can start at https://www.staffflowai.com/wordpress-ai-chatbot/.
  2. In WordPress Admin, go to Plugins → Add New, search for StaffFlow AI, select Install Now, then Activate.
  3. Open StaffFlow AI in the WordPress Admin sidebar. Your WordPress website must use HTTPS.
  4. Select Connect StaffFlow AI. Sign in directly on StaffFlow, choose your configured AI, review the exact website address, and approve the one-time connection.
  5. You return to WordPress automatically. Open a public page of your website and check the Widget. StaffFlow’s installation status distinguishes a prepared connection from a confirmed Widget load.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a StaffFlow account?

Yes. The connection page requires a StaffFlow AI account and a configured AI employee.

Does the plugin need my WordPress or StaffFlow password?

No. You sign in directly on StaffFlow. This plugin never asks for or stores a StaffFlow password, access token, or API key.

What data does the plugin store in WordPress?

Only a non-secret connection ID, the selected AI ID and name, and the local connection time. It does not store visitor conversations, visitor contact details, passwords, API keys, or access tokens.

How do I disconnect the Widget?

Open StaffFlow AI in WordPress Admin and choose Remove Widget from this WordPress site. You can also revoke the website from your StaffFlow workspace.

Why is HTTPS required?

StaffFlow binds an AI employee to the exact secure website origin. The plugin does not offer a connection flow for non-HTTPS websites.

What is Website Knowledge Launch?

It is an optional handoff from this plugin to the StaffFlow knowledge page for the AI you connected. The public website address is pre-filled, but StaffFlow imports nothing until an authorized owner reviews the address and checks the confirmation box. StaffFlow reads up to five public HTML pages from the approved domain only.

Does the Site Health check send information to StaffFlow?

No. The WordPress Site Health check reads only the local connection metadata. It does not make a StaffFlow network request and does not inspect visitor conversations.

Is everything free?

The WordPress plugin is free and open source. The connected AI service has its own plans and usage limits. Creating or installing the plugin does not start a paid subscription automatically.

Can I collect leads or guarantee sales?

When configured in StaffFlow, the Widget can collect a visitor’s voluntary follow-up request in your StaffFlow Lead Inbox. The plugin does not store those requests in WordPress. Leads and sales are not guaranteed; results depend on traffic, business information, your offer, and follow-up.
sections.changelog:
1.1.0

  • Adds Website Knowledge Launch: a secure, explicit handoff from a connected WordPress site to the matching AI’s StaffFlow knowledge page.
  • Adds a local-only Site Health connection check and non-secret connection information for WordPress administrators.
  • Adds a direct Settings link on the WordPress Plugins screen and clearer setup guidance.
  • Rechecked the connection flow against WordPress Coding Standards and PHP syntax validation.

1.0.3

  • Adds a WordPress administrator-session nonce to the existing one-time connection return flow.
  • Rechecks all plugin request paths for administrator capability, input sanitization, validation, and escaped output.

1.0.2

  • Removes a redundant Author URI header required by the WordPress.org submission validator.

1.0.1

  • Adds the WordPress tested-version declaration.
  • Removes an unused language-directory header.

1.0.0

  • Initial public release.
  • Secure, one-time WordPress connection flow for StaffFlow AI.
  • Administrator-only setup and local disconnect controls.
  • Suggested privacy-policy content.
